item: 6-1348 gh1-016 #1 — 매 순간(문제의 첫 뜻) = every moment
add: He enjoys every moment of the trip.
wrong: He enjoys every moment of the day.
She enjoys every moment of the trip.

add: None of the boys receive a prize.
None of the boys receives a prize.
No boys receive a prize.
wrong: No girl receives a prize.
All the boys receive a prize.

add: Whenever I went to school, the teacher welcomed me.
wrong: Whenever I went to school, the teacher scolded me.

item: 6-1348 #12 — 얼마나 많이(대상 없음) — how many 도
add: How many do you want?
wrong: How many does he want?

add: Do you have any more?
wrong: Does he have any more?

add: What time does she go to sleep?
wrong: What time does she get up?

add: Did you have a great dinner?
wrong: Did you have a great lunch?

add: How many days were you in America?
wrong: How many days were you in Korea?

item: 6-1349 #10 — 가는 길을 물을 땐 get there · 주어 없는 문제라 I 도
add: How do you get there?
How do I get there?
How do I go there?
wrong: How do you get here?
When do you get there?

add: How did all the girls get there?
wrong: How did all the boys get there?

item: 6-1350 #14 — than you do(9/17 G1-30 이 gh1-060 에서 같은 꼴을 받음)
add: I have more money than you do.
wrong: I have less money than you do.
You have more money than I do.

add: He finished it as quickly as possible.
He finished it as fast as possible.
He finished it as soon as he could.
wrong: He started it as soon as possible.
He finished it as slowly as possible.

item: 6-1354 gh1-020 #6 — 우리 부모님 = our parents 도 · home
add: Our parents are at home.
My parents are home.
wrong: Your parents are at home.
My parents are at school.

add: I come from Korea.
wrong: I come from Japan.
He comes from Korea.

add: Weren't they books?
Were they not books?

Were they books?
